verdicts.note: The renewal signals are real: he is a first-time candidate running on 'A New Kind of Leadership' and leadership 'built on merit' over seniority [S1][S2]. But the same statement leads with his record: '20 years as a litigator', 'the only candidate with experience in both the Criminal and Civil divisions of our Prosecutor's Office', and encouragement to run from fellow prosecutors and elected officials [S1]. He has worked inside the office since 2019 [S3][S5] and carries the Democratic Party, labor and legislator endorsement pattern [S4]. Neither side dominates, so the profile reads as mixed rather than toward the outsider pole. Scoring the in-office deputy +1 while the outside defense attorney sits at -1 also inverts the insider/outsider contrast the contest file describes.
